caption:
Tracking your mood sounds like self-awareness. But for an overthinker's brain, every data point becomes a question to analyze. Every dip becomes a problem to solve. You're not managing your anxiety — you're monitoring it into a spiral. The Check-Out replaces surveillance with a single sentence. DM "DETOX" for the full 7-Day Overthinking Detox. Save this.
